Location.blurb: MAZJ is in Al-Khobar's Al-Olaya district, inside Life Tower on Zaid Ibn Alkhattab St. Every desk, office, and room you need is here, under one roof.

items.q: Can I see it before I commit?
items.a: We'd love that. Book a free tour on WhatsApp during staffed hours, or start with a day pass and see the place working. When you decide to join, your day pass counts in full toward your first month.
Our team welcomes you Sunday to Thursday, 9am to 5pm. Space subscribers and private-office holders come and go on their own schedule, any hour, 24/7.
In Al-Khobar's Al-Olaya district: Life Tower, Zaid Ibn Alkhattab St. The tower is easy to spot from the main road, and reception will point you to the right floor on your first visit.

items.q: Can I take calls from my desk?
items.a: Of course. Short calls at your desk are welcome. When you need a longer or more private call, book the Al-Malqa meeting room by the hour, or ask the team at reception what's free.

You're always welcome to bring people along. A day pass and a monthly subscription are each for one person, so when you're meeting guests, book the Al-Malqa room to host them properly, or just ask the team at reception during staffed hours.
Reaching Life Tower by car is easy, and parking is available around the tower. Ask the team for the closest option when you arrive.

items.q: Can I get a 24/7 private office in Al-Khobar?
items.a: Yes. A monthly private office at MAZJ in Al-Khobar gives you 24/7 access, so you reach your office any hour of any day. Daily private offices run during staffed hours, Sunday to Thursday, 9am to 5pm.

items.q: What's the difference between a day pass and a monthly subscription?
items.a: A day pass gives you a full day in the shared space, completely at ease. A space subscription runs monthly and adds 24/7 access and 15% off the Al-Malqa meeting room. Both are booked here.

items.q: What's included with a desk or office?
items.a: Fast Wi-Fi, free drinks, and the shared areas come with every plan. Space subscribers enjoy 15% off the Al-Malqa meeting room, and monthly private offices get 20% off.

items.q: How do I book the meeting room?
items.a: Al-Malqa is booked by the hour, seats up to 6, and comes with a screen and a writable wall. Space subscribers and monthly private offices enjoy a discount on the rate.

Each booking is reserved just for you and held for your chosen date, so it stays non-refundable once it's placed. If your plans change, reach out before your booking date and we'll gladly help you find another time that works.

items.q: Is there a day pass for coworking in Al-Khobar?
items.a: Yes. MAZJ, in Al-Khobar, offers a day pass for its shared coworking space: a full day at an open desk with fast Wi-Fi and free drinks, booked right here. Your day pass counts in full toward your first month if you go on to join.

items.q: Is there an hourly meeting room in Al-Khobar?
items.a: Yes. Al-Malqa, MAZJ's meeting room in Al-Khobar, is booked by the hour. It seats up to 6 and comes with a screen and a writable wall, so you pay only for the time you meet.

items.q: Can I host an event at MAZJ?
items.a: We'd be glad to host you. Al-Ma'arij is our events hall, booked in 2 to 5 hour slots. It suits workshops, meetups, launches, and training days.

items.q: How many people fit in the hall?
items.a: Al-Ma'arij seats up to 30, with a screen and a sound system ready to go. Tell the team what you're running and they'll set the room up around it.

items.q: Where can I run a 30-person workshop in Al-Khobar?
items.a: Al-Ma'arij, MAZJ's events hall in Al-Khobar, seats up to 30 with a screen and sound system. Book it in 2 to 5 hour slots for a workshop, a training day, or a meetup.
Payment is simple: by card, or split into installments with Tamara or Tabby where available.

items.q: Can I get a VAT invoice?
items.a: Yes. MAZJ is VAT-registered with tax number 310240548700003, and a tax invoice is issued for your booking on request.

TermsPage.title: Terms of Service
TermsPage.intro: The terms that govern your bookings, your subscription, and your use of the MAZJ space.

sections.body: MAZJ (مزج) is a shared workspace operated by MAZJ Al-Omrania One Person Company, registered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, at Life Tower, Zaid Ibn Alkhattab Street, Al-Olaya, Al-Khobar. These terms govern your use of our website (mazj.org), your bookings made through it, and the MAZJ space itself. Our VAT registration number is shown at the foot of this page.

By booking a space, entering the premises, or using our website, you agree to these terms. You must be at least 18 years old and have the legal capacity to enter into an agreement. Where you accept online, your electronic acceptance is valid and binding under the Electronic Transactions Law of Saudi Arabia, with the same effect as a signature.

A booking or subscription gives you a limited, revocable licence to use the space and services you have paid for. It is not a lease or tenancy, and gives you no ownership or property interest in the premises. Depending on your plan, it may include the open desk, a private office (حيّز), the meeting room (Al-Malqa), the events hall (Al-Ma'arij), or a day pass.

Spaces are booked on our website and paid for at the prices shown at checkout. Prices are in Saudi Riyals and include 15% VAT unless stated otherwise, and a tax invoice is issued for each purchase in line with ZATCA rules. Payment methods include cards, Tamara and Tabby. Subscriptions renew and are billed as described on your plan, with fees payable in advance.

Bookings are made for a specific date or period. Once a booking is confirmed, the fee is non-refundable, and the events hall may require a deposit. Where Saudi consumer law gives a cancellation right, it applies only where the service has not yet been used and the booking is not for a fixed date that has passed. If your plans change, contact us before your booked time and we will help where we can. Any refundable deposit is returned after your account is settled.

Eligible space subscribers are given 24/7 access using a personal digital access credential, a QR code or an access card, issued through our booking system; the space is also staffed during opening hours. Your access credential is personal and must not be shared, lent or transferred, and you must not let anyone enter behind you without their own access. Tell us immediately if your credential is lost or misused. We may enter any area for cleaning, maintenance, inspection, security or emergencies.

MAZJ is a shared, professional space. We ask everyone to be respectful and considerate, and we do not tolerate harassment or discrimination of any kind. Please keep noise reasonable, keep shared areas tidy, and follow Saudi law and local norms of public conduct. Smoking and vaping indoors, alcohol, and any unlawful or improper activity are not allowed.

You are welcome to bring guests within the limits of your plan. Guests should be registered, sign in at reception, and stay with you during their visit. You are responsible for your guests' conduct and for any damage they cause. Deliveries and couriers are received at reception.

sections.h: How the space may not be used
sections.body: You may not run a competing coworking or workspace business from MAZJ, and you may not resell, sublet or transfer your desk, access or subscription to anyone else. You may not use MAZJ's address as your registered, commercial or legal address without a separate written agreement with us. Illegal activity, and weapons or hazardous materials, are strictly prohibited.

The meeting room (Al-Malqa) and events hall (Al-Ma'arij) are booked through our booking system and are subject to time and capacity limits. A no-show or a late cancellation may forfeit the fee. Events in Al-Ma'arij may be subject to setup and teardown arrangements and to sign-off by our team.

You are responsible for your own belongings; MAZJ is not responsible for personal property that is lost, stolen or damaged on the premises. You are responsible for any damage that you or your guests cause to MAZJ's property or equipment. We recommend that you arrange your own insurance for your property and business.

We provide internet access for your work, but we cannot guarantee that it will always be available or secure, so please keep your own devices protected. You must not use our network for anything unlawful or abusive, and we may disconnect any device that threatens the network or anyone else using the space.

The MAZJ name, logo, website and content belong to us. You may use the website and services for your own personal and business use in line with these terms, but you may not copy, reproduce or reuse our brand or content without our written permission.

To the fullest extent allowed by Saudi law, MAZJ's total liability to you for any claim is limited to the amount you paid for the booking that gave rise to it, and we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss such as lost profit or business. Nothing in these terms limits or excludes liability for fraud, gross negligence, death or personal injury, or anything else that cannot be excluded under Saudi law.

We may suspend or end your access if you break these terms, if fees are unpaid, or if your conduct is unlawful or incompatible with a shared workspace. When your access ends, you must remove your belongings, leave the premises, and settle any outstanding balance.
We handle your personal data as described in our Privacy Policy, which forms part of these terms, in line with the Personal Data Protection Law of Saudi Arabia.
We may update these terms from time to time. The date at the top shows when they last changed, and by continuing to use our services after a change you accept the updated terms.

These terms are governed by the laws and regulations of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the principles of Islamic Sharia. Any dispute arising from them, or from your use of our services, is subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia in the Eastern Province (Al-Khobar).

MAZJ is operated by MAZJ Al-Omrania One Person Company, at Life Tower, Zaid Ibn Alkhattab Street, Al-Olaya, Al-Khobar. For any question about these terms, reach us through the contact page, on WhatsApp, or by email at info@mazj.org. Our Commercial Registration and VAT numbers are shown below.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.intro: How MAZJ collects, uses, and protects your personal data, under the Personal Data Protection Law of Saudi Arabia.

sections.body: MAZJ (مزج) is operated by MAZJ Al-Omrania One Person Company, a company registered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, at Life Tower, Zaid Ibn Alkhattab Street, Al-Olaya, Al-Khobar. For the purposes of the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL), we are the party that controls how your personal data is processed. Our website (mazj.org) and our booking store (mazj.sa) are operated by the same company.

This policy explains how we handle personal data when you visit our website, book or pay on our website, contact us, or use the MAZJ space as a space subscriber or visitor. It follows the Personal Data Protection Law of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and its regulations, overseen by the Saudi Data & AI Authority (SDAIA).

Depending on how you interact with us, we may collect:
• Contact and account details you give us, such as your name, phone number and email.
• Booking and payment details when you reserve a space with us.
• The access credential we issue you (a QR code or an access card) to enter the space, and records of your entry.
• Footage from security cameras (CCTV) in and around the premises.
• Website and device information, including cookies, IP address and how you use the site.
• The content of your messages when you contact us by WhatsApp, email or the contact form.
Space subscribers enter the space using a personal digital access credential, a QR code or an access card, issued through our booking system. We keep a record of entry to help keep the space secure.

We operate CCTV in common and entry areas to keep subscribers, guests and property safe. Footage is kept for a limited period and then deleted, is accessible only to authorised staff, and is shared outside MAZJ only where the law requires it.

We use your data to:
• Manage your bookings and subscriptions (to perform our agreement with you).
• Operate secure access to the space and keep it safe.
• Respond to your enquiries and provide support.
• Meet our legal, tax and invoicing obligations, including ZATCA requirements.
• Keep the site secure and improve it.
• Send you updates or offers only where you have given us separate, explicit consent, which you can withdraw at any time.

Our website uses cookies and analytics tools (such as Google Analytics) to understand how the site is used and to improve it. You can control or block cookies through your browser settings, though some parts of the site may not work as intended if you do.

sections.h: Who we share your data with
sections.body:
We share personal data only as needed to run our service:
• Our booking and payments platform (Rekaz), which processes your booking and passes your payment to the provider you choose.
• Payment providers such as Tamara, Tabby and card networks. We do not store your full card details.
• Our hosting and IT providers.
• Government authorities where we are legally required to disclose it.
We do not sell your personal data.

Some of our service providers may process data outside the Kingdom. Where that happens, we transfer only what is necessary and rely on the conditions and safeguards allowed under the PDPL and the Regulation on Personal Data Transfer Outside the Kingdom.

sections.h: How long we keep your data
sections.body: We keep personal data only as long as we need it for the purpose we collected it, or as long as the law requires. Tax and invoicing records are kept for the period required by ZATCA. Your access credential is deactivated when your subscription ends, and entry records and CCTV footage are kept on a short rolling basis before they are deleted.

We use organisational and technical measures to protect your data, and we limit access to staff who need it. No system can be guaranteed completely secure, but we work to keep your data safe and to respond quickly to any incident.

Under the PDPL you have the right to:
• Be informed about how your data is used.
• Access your data and obtain a copy of it.
• Correct data that is inaccurate or out of date.
• Ask us to delete your data.
• Withdraw your consent at any time.
To exercise any of these, contact us through the details below, and we will respond within 30 days. If you are not satisfied, you may complain to the Saudi Data & AI Authority (SDAIA) through the National Data Governance Platform.
Our services are meant for adults. We do not knowingly collect the personal data of anyone under 18. If you believe a child has given us their data, contact us and we will remove it.

We may update this policy from time to time; the date at the top shows when it last changed. For any privacy question or request, reach us through the contact page or on WhatsApp, or by email at info@mazj.org. You can also contact the Saudi Data & AI Authority (SDAIA) if you wish to raise a concern with the regulator.
